monthly_totals.en: What are the invoice total, credit memo total, and net amount of valid A/R documents in {month}, in local currency?

weekly_trend.en: Show the weekly trend of net A/R document amounts in {month}.
weekly_trend.zh: 请按周展示 {month} 有效应收单据净额趋势。

customer_top_five.en: Rank the top five customers by net A/R document amounts in {month}.
customer_top_five.zh: 请列出 {month} 有效应收单据净额最高的五个客户。
